description: Cigars, cheroots and cigarillos: containing tobacco including the weight of every band, wrapper or attachment thereto
Poultry: live, ducks, geese, turkeys and guinea fowls, weighing more than 185g
Mammals: live, whales, dolphins and porpoises (mammals of the order Cetacea): manatees and dugongs (mammals of the order Sirenia): seals, sea lions and walruses (mammals of the suborder Pinnipedia)
Sugars: cane sugar, raw, in solid form, as specified in Subheading Note 2 to this chapter, not containing added flavouring or colouring matter
Graphite: natural, in other forms, excluding powder or flakes

Radioactive elements, isotopes, compounds, n.e.c. in heading no. 2844 alloys, dispersions (including cermets), ceramic products and mixtures containing these elements, isotopes or compounds: radioactive residues
Glands and other organs: extracts of glands or other organs or of their secretions, for organo-therapeutic uses
Fuses and detonators: safety or detonating fuses, percussion or detonating caps, igniters, electric detonators
Fabrics, woven: of jute or of other textile bast fibres of heading no. 5303, other than unbleached
Nickel: oxide sinters and other intermediate products of nickel metallurgy
Engines: compression-ignition internal combustion piston engines (diesel or semi-diesel engines), of a kind used for other than marine propulsion or the vehicles of chapter 87
